items.name: block-editor
items.title: Block editor
items.description: A Notion-style block editor for React: the / menu, a drag handle, a formatting bubble, tables, to-do lists, callouts and code, in light and dark. One <Editor /> component in components/editor.tsx, built on GoTipe. The ready UI is under the GoTipe Commercial License: free for personal, non-profit and education use, OSI open-source projects, companies under USD 1M revenue, and evaluation.
items.author: GoTipe <https://gotipe.com>
items.docs: Render <Editor /> from components/editor.tsx; it is a client component. onChange gets the editor: read the document with editor.getJSON() or editor.getMarkdown(). Docs: https://gotipe.com/docs/ui/block-editor/
